scope: Printable ASCII and LF, body-only Fountain accepted by Renderflow's strict native parser. Scene headings and character cues are exact source text; repeated headings remain separate occurrences. Counts do not infer locations, character identities, spoken duration, or PDF layout and are not afterwriting statistics.
token_unit: ASCII whitespace-delimited tokens; punctuation remains attached and parentheticals are excluded from dialogue word counts.
